Impressive return on a heavy track. Honest sort who can again prove hard to toss, especially if there is more rain about.
Finished too well for them fresh before relishing the heavy here, winning again. No luck at Sandown latest.
Endured a tough run out wide when resuming. Much better second up, not disgraced in town latest. Go well.
Racing in flying form this prep, winning three of four. Always in control here at latest. Go well again.
Honest gelding who was just too strong when resuming at this track. Second up form also good, go well again.
Did not have an easy run out wide on pace at first run since late May. Look for an improved showing.
Resumes off a couple of unplaced Cranbourne jumpouts. Has run well fresh and overall record is a consistent one.
Fair run on Pakenham synthetic when resuming, though she never looked a winning hope. Won two of three last prep.
Won three in a row before another bold showing last time, nabbed only late. Can once again give them something to chase.
Resumes off a local jumpout win. Was in great form last time in and is one to keep a close eye on.
Was not in the best going when resuming in a similar race here. Better for it with place claims.
Covered ground first up and it was a solid showing here second up. Fitter again with good each-way claims.
Ran boldly at first run since early Feb, getting to the lead only to be outgunned by one out wider. Go well.
Sound showings at two runs this time in and better for them. Each-way contender.
Was up in weight when failing to fire last time, ok at previous outing. Capable of better.
Showed second up improvement on the synthetic, getting too far back last time. Each-way show back to grass.

CalendarEntryDetail.Summary: Find out everything you need to know about race day at Sale! Here, you'll find racecourse information, gate opening times and all of the other important information that you need to plan your perfect...

source.current_gear: Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME
source.gear_changes: Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME
source.comment: Resuming (23 weeks). Showed speed and faded on debut. Placed in a recent Pakenham Synthetic jumpout since and can show more here.
Began awkwardly at Ballarat last start and ran on strongly. Perennial placegetter who can break through.

source.current_gear: Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Lugging Bit OFF FIRST TIME
source.gear_changes: Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Lugging Bit OFF FIRST TIME
source.comment: Resuming (22 weeks). Long-time maiden who ran on honestly late at Yarra Valley before the break. Shapes as a threat fresh in this field.
First foal from a mare that placed three times. Ran fifth in a February jumpout and looks one to watch rather than back on debut.
Beaten a long distance on debut at Mt Gambier. Jumped out well prior to that and the tongue-tie goes on. Sharp improvement anticipated.
$600 purchase whose half-sister won at her only start. Ran fifth in two recent Victorian jumpouts and prefer to see more.
$2k purchase who is the first foal out of a Donald Classic winner. Ran third at a recent Ballarat Synthetic jumpout and worth noting.
Began awkwardly two back. Kept grinding away for third here last start. Each-way contender again.
Resuming (144 weeks). Slowly away and had a slow recovery at Horsham before the break. Long time off and see this one.
Let-up (46 days, ex Stephen Brown). Lost ground from an awkward start at Seymour last start. New stable now.
Freshened (28 days). Chased solidly at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Ran fourth in a jumpout since and can run a bold race third-up.
Resuming (38 weeks, ex A & S Freedman). Dwelt at start on debut. Since placed in a Caulfield Heath trial and looms as a danger.
Resuming (31 weeks, ex David Hall). Ran second in a recent Mornington jumpout. Hong Kong form was poor, but don't take lightly.
Pressed forward but couldn't keep going at Kyneton two back. Raced keenly at Mt Gambier first up and will need to settle better.

source.current_gear: Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME
source.gear_changes: Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME
source.comment: Resuming (23 weeks). Showed speed and faded on debut. Placed in a recent Pakenham Synthetic jumpout since and can show more here.
Surged late when midfield here two back. Stormed home and just missed here last start. Keep very safe third-up.
Full brother to multiple city winner Trajection. Ran third in his latest St Arnaud jumpout and worth keeping an eye on.
Keen and failed to handle the going at Moe two back. Rider lost whip at Ballarat Synthetic last start when giving a good sight.
Resuming (29 weeks). Fought right to the line on debut at Stawell. Showed promise in defeat and looks set to benefit from the experience.
On speed but tired at Stawell two back. Raced handy and faded first-up at Ballarat Synthetic. Can improve second-up.
Tried hard when well held at Ballarat two back. Gave all to the line here last start and can figure third-up.
Same sire as Manaal, half to Bendigo Cup winner Red Alto. Third and first in Ballarat synthetic jumpouts. Keep safe.
Wide/okay at Geelong before break. Laid out in the straight at Pakenham Synthetic first run back. Can make an impact second-up.
Cost $360k. Out of a stakes-winning dam and took out his most recent Donald jumpout showing speed and leading clearly.
Hit the line well here last start. It was an improved showing. Rise to 1200m looks ideal.
Resuming (10 weeks). Struggled home at Flemington last start. Won a recent Pakenham Synthetic jumpout and looks ready to show more fresh.

source.current_gear: Blinkers FIRST TIME, Lugging Bit FIRST TIME
source.gear_changes: Blinkers FIRST TIME, Lugging Bit FIRST TIME
source.comment: $360k purchase whose full sister I Choose You was Group 2 placed. Ran third at a recent Werribee jumpout and looks one to follow closely.
Slowly away at Pakenham Synthetic two back. Began awkwardly and raced wide here last start. Can run a bold race here.
Ran on fairly for minor placing here first up. Remains a long-time maiden and faces a deeper field here.
Resuming (30 weeks). Walked home well beaten on debut at Echuca. Since trialled poorly at Bendigo and needs to show more.
Raced three wide on debut at Bairnsdale. Needs to show more second-up to be competitive in this.

source.current_gear: Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME
source.gear_changes: Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME
source.comment: Well beaten on debut at Avoca and has plenty to find off the run here when resuming earlier in the month. Not yet.
Resuming (22 weeks, ex John Sargent). Finished lame at Wyong before the break. Won a recent jumpout and the market will tell the story.
Surged late when midfield here two back. Stormed home and just missed here last start. Keep very safe third-up.
Keen when close up at Ballarat Synthetic two back. Keen again when runner-up at Donald last start. In the mix.
Slowly away at Mornington two back. Raced three wide when close up here last start and can improve again third-up.
Nosed out late when handy here two back. Tried hard last start and can break through here.
Freshened (28 days). Raced wide when close up here two back. Battled on at Albury last start. Back on the synthetic today.
On speed but tired at Donald two back. Slowly away when close up at Ballarat Synthetic last start. Looks ready to break through.
Began awkwardly and raced three wide at Ballarat Synthetic last start. Long-time maiden who needs to find more to break through.
Fought hard when close up here two back. Never a factor last start, but okay late and has place claims.
Raced three wide here two back. Pace-setter but weakened last start and has plenty to find.
Got back from a wide alley first up. Didn't finish off from a forward role here next time. Fitter. Bad draw.
Slowly away when close up two back. Caught the eye late last start. Drawn to advantage and can run a bold race.
Freshened (37 days). Whacked away at Seymour two back. Keen and got its head up at Donald last start. Racing well enough.
Showed keenness when finishing for a close third here at first run back from a long spell. Can take the next step second-up.

source.current_gear: Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME, Norton Bit FIRST TIME
source.gear_changes: Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME, Norton Bit FIRST TIME
source.comment: Slowly away and well beaten at Sandown Hillside on debut. Rises to 1500m second-up and can show more on drier track.
Resuming (30 weeks). Left trailing a long way back on debut at Echuca. Ran fifth in a recent Bendigo trial and will need to show more.
Began awkwardly and lost considerable ground on debut at Pakenham Synthetic. Worth including again in a race that should suit better.
Freshened (31 days). Well beaten at Stawell two back. Kept grinding away at Ballarat Synthetic last start. Prefer others in this.
Freshened (28 days). Beaten out of sight at Bairnsdale two back. Raced wide without cover at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Prefer others.

source.current_gear: Cheekers FIRST TIME, Norton Bit OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME, Visors OFF FIRST TIME, Winkers AGAIN
source.gear_changes: Cheekers FIRST TIME, Norton Bit OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME, Visors OFF FIRST TIME, Winkers AGAIN
source.comment: Resuming (13 weeks). Walked home well beaten at Deniliquin before the break. Faces a stern test.
Keen when close up at Ballarat Synthetic two back. Keen again when runner-up at Donald last start. In the mix.
Slowly away at Ballarat Synthetic two back before finishing close up. Slowly away again at Flemington last start. Better placed here.
Began awkwardly and lost ground two back. Slowly away again last start and faces another stern test.
Slowly away two back before running on for second. Began awkwardly again at Mildura last start. Some chance.
On a quick back-up. Bucked at start when runner-up at Warrnambool last start. Can be competitive.
Well beaten at Casterton two back. Began awkwardly at Donald last start. Will need to find plenty more to figure in this.
On a quick back-up. Plodded home at Pakenham Synthetic two back. Slowly away there last start. Rises to 2200m and this is not strong.
Took trail and whacked away here two back. One paced when fourth here last start. Finds a winnable race.
Ran on for third at Bendigo. Third-up now and ready to peak in a winnable maiden. Gets his chance.
Keen early at Donald two back. Began awkwardly last start and has ground to make up in this field.
Raced keenly when fifth at Ballarat Synthetic two back. Proved difficult to ride out at Coleraine last start. Prefer others.

source.current_gear: Pacifiers FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME
source.gear_changes: Pacifiers FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME
source.comment: Freshened (34 days). Uncompetitive when slowly away at Echuca last start. Adds a tongue-tie now and the firmer surface may help.
Slowly away at Ballarat Synthetic two back before finishing close up. Slowly away again at Flemington last start. Better placed here.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Safely accounted for rivals to win here two back. Raced three wide when runner-up last start and drops in grade now.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Keen when narrowly beaten here two back. Began awkwardly at Mildura last start and ran into traffic. Can bounce back with the rise in trip.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Raced keenly when close up at Echuca two back. Made no impact at Seymour last start. First go synthetic, improver?

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Freshened (31 days). No threat from midfield here when first-up. Has since had a hurdle trial and can improve.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Battled away solidly at Ballarat Synthetic two back. Struggled to the line at Mildura last start and needs to lift sharply.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: On a quick back-up. Kept grinding away at Sale two back. Raced keenly at Pakenham Synthetic last start and can play a minor role here.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Safely held here two back. Never a threat at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Rises in trip and looks well-suited now.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Tried hard when narrowly beaten here two back. Miles back and never a threat last start. Drops in grade, can hit back.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Rider told to use more vigour two back. Always well back last start. Give another chance in open race.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Raced keenly over this trip two back. Lost a winker here last time and was plain. Winkers off now. Place preferred.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: On a quick back-up. Slowly away when well beaten at Bairnsdale two back. Never threatened at Moe last start and has much to find.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Began awkwardly two back. Slowly away at Donald last start and needs to find plenty more here.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Won despite laying out in the straight two back. Whacked away at Donald last start. Returns to synthetic here.

source.race_name: Smith and Sons Ballarat BM56 Handicap
source.comment: Safely accounted for rivals to win here two back. Raced three wide when runner-up last start and drops in grade now.
Gave all to the line at Ballarat Synthetic last start. Can run a bold race third-up.
Resuming (15 weeks). On speed but tired at Terang before the break. Drops in grade and loves this track so can bounce back fresh.
Began awkwardly two back and met trouble. Slowly away but ran home strongly to win last start. Tougher here, but include.
Slowly away at Swan Hill two back. Began awkwardly and tailed off at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Needs to find plenty more.
Freshened (30 days). Laid in down the straight at Seymour two back. Pace-setter but weakened at Caulfield last start. Drops in grade now.
Dictated terms and won well first-up at Donald. Failed to handle the going at Sale last start. Firmer footing today should suit.
Even run but outsprinted in the straight at Mildura last start. Ran on well here prior, speed on up front would suit.
Slowly away but ran on well to win last start. Faces a similar test today. In flying form and rates highly.
Laid in but rallied to win here last start. Can be competitive for a long way, 1000m is his best distance.
On speed and too tough to win on the synthetic last start. Rises in grade third-up but looks well placed for another bold showing.
Resuming (50 weeks). Won a jumpout at Seymour in June. Last of four in a Wangaratta hitout since. Betting guides.
Let-up (44 days). Pulled hard and checked mid-race when never likely at Bendigo last start. Possible improver.
Laid in down the straight here two back. On speed and narrowly beaten at Mildura last start. Needs things to fall her way.
Safely held at Mildura two back. Kept grinding away at Ballarat Synthetic last start but never threatened. Prefer others in this.
Gave all to the line at Ballarat Synthetic last start. Can run a bold race third-up.
Gave all but fell short at this track first run back. Drops in grade and warrants plenty of attention.
Won well here two back. Failed to quicken last start. One for the wider exotics in this line-up.
Freshened (35 days, ex Lloyd Kennewell). Slowly away at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Has ability and must be kept safe.
Freshened (34 days). Laid in when winning at Swan Hill two back. Finished strongly to win again at Echuca last start. Looks hard to beat.
Resuming (18 weeks). Tried hard when well held at Launceston before the break. Had a quiet Mortlake jumpout since and can measure up here.
Won here fresh. Kept grinding from the rear here last start. Can show more third-up.
Raced wide without cover but still broke through to win at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Rises in grade now but the confidence is there.

source.comment: Freshened (34 days). Struggled in heavy going at Echuca first run back. Can bounce back second-up.

source.comment: Showed poor racing manners when well beaten at Geelong first-up off a very long spell. Prefer others.
Dropped off completely here two back. Safely held in the pack last start and place claims look best.
Checked when trying to run on in traffic here first up. Drops back in trip second-up and can show more.
Kept trying when safely held two back. Raced keenly at Bairnsdale last start and was okay. Place claims.
Raced without cover here two back when well backed. Handy but faded badly at Donald last start. Back on the synthetic now.
Raced wide with cover at Wodonga two back. Never a factor at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Prefer others in this.
Began awkwardly and raced wide without cover here last start. Still has plenty to find here.
Passed several late up the straight when third at this venue first-up. Faces a stiffer test in this harder race second-up.
Beaten but gave all on the synthetic two back. Drops back to 1200m after the vet certificate run last start (EIPH).
Gave all but fell short at this track first run back. Drops in grade and warrants plenty of attention.
Slowly away two back. Raced wide when runner-up last start and the apprentice claims again. Right in the finish.
Slowly away when well beaten at Cranbourne two back. Plodded home there last start. One for the wider exotics.
Lame and raced below expectations at Echuca two back. Rider reported concerns with action at Seymour last start. Faces a tough ask.
Slowly away but ran on strongly to win last start. Rises in grade now but can measure up again.
Won narrowly here two back. Tried hard but well held here last start. Wangaratta jumpout winner since and worth thought.
Freshened (38 days). Won well at Kilmore two back. Slowly away and raced keenly at Geelong last start. Can atone here.
Ran on strongly for second two back. Laid in when winning over this trip last start. Rises in grade now.
Let-up (44 days). Made strong inroads at Werribee two back. Sat back and rattled home at Bendigo last start. Can be competitive third-up.
Resuming (10 weeks). Lost a plate and raced below expectations at Kilmore last start. Finished last in a recent Ballarat Synthetic jumpout.
Rounded up rivals to win here two back. Surged late when close up last start and rates highly here.
Showed speed but faded at Donald two back. Began awkwardly there last start and one for the wider exotics here.
Freshened (37 days). Settled midfield with no finish at Mt Gambier two back. Slowly away at Donald last start. Prefer others.
Failed to handle the going and raced below expectations at Bairnsdale last start. Can atone for that poor showing here.

source.comment: Struggled home when first-up at Donald two back. Replated at the barriers last start before fading in the run home and needs to lift.
Held position in pack at Ballarat Synthetic first run back. Rises in trip now and has place claims.
No threat from midfield at Ararat then turned in an improved showing on the synthetic here last time.
Overraced early at Mornington two back. Began awkwardly and overraced again last start. Prefer others in this.
Slowly away two back. Raced wide when runner-up last start and the apprentice claims again. Right in the finish.
